goal: Show how stale refuge counts are on the migration dashboard, with a green/amber/red badge, so users can tell whether the weekly survey data is current.

facts: GET /api/refuges/migration/dashboard returns currentCounts[].surveyDate but NO ingestion timestamp (apps/api/src/routes/refuges.ts:262-291)
refuge_counts table has BOTH survey_date and created_at; created_at exists in schema but is never selected by any route (packages/db/src/schema/index.ts:233-251)
MigrationPage already computes latestDate = max(surveyDate) and renders a 'Latest Survey' stat card — natural badge site (apps/web/src/pages/MigrationPage.tsx:1732-1734, 2374-2379)
No shared type: dashboard response shape is hand-duplicated in apps/web/src/lib/api.ts:281-323; API and web can silently drift
No Badge/Pill component exists; ad-hoc Tailwind pills driven by STATUS_CONFIG lookup (MigrationPage.tsx:157-164)
No date-fns/dayjs/moment anywhere in the monorepo; dates use toLocaleDateString()
apps/api has vitest (63 tests) but none cover refuges.ts; apps/web has zero test files
tsc --noEmit clean in both apps/api and apps/web
unknowns: Does 'stalled' mean survey_date age, created_at-vs-survey_date gap, or actual scraper run success? Only survey_date age is derivable today
One aggregate badge or per-refuge/per-source? The 6 sources have different cadences (weekly/biweekly/monthly/annual)
Should the new badge interact with the existing season-rollover isStale logic, or stay separate?
risks: PLAN-KILLER: currentCounts mixes surveyType 'weekly' and 'mwi_annual' rows (refuges.ts:230-233). A naive days-since-surveyDate badge shows RED for annual-survey refuges when nothing is wrong. Must filter by surveyType before computing freshness.
NAME COLLISION: codebase already uses isStale/hasStaleData to mean 'previous hunting season' (60-day / Feb-1 thresholds) at MigrationPage.tsx:1715-1735. A 7-14 day badge needs a distinct name.
Scraper health is not in the DB at all — only flat-file logs + optional webhook. 'Stalled scraper' detection has no data source today.
LIVE ISSUE: scripts/logs/refuge-counts-2026-08-10.log:27 and refuge-counts-2026-08-18.log:27 both show 'Refuge scraper FAILED (exit 1)' — two consecutive weekly runs failed
Duplicated response type means adding an API field requires manually editing apps/web/src/lib/api.ts — no compiler-enforced link
No test coverage on refuges.ts or anywhere in apps/web — new threshold logic would ship with no regression net
